parts.name: Translation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the translation blade of a knife, made of stainless steel. It is a long, thin, and sharp component designed for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting action. It translates or slides out from the base body when the knife is used, providing a sharp edge for slicing or cutting materials.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out of the base body, allowing for extension and retraction during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of a knife, made of aluminum alloy. It serves as the handle and housing for the translation blade.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and a comfortable grip for the user. It also contains the mechanism that allows the blade to slide in and out safely.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main support structure while the blade moves relative to it.
